name: MR BEAST LAND! - Riyadh Season
desc:
The Beast Land update is now live! Meet Mr Beast in game and challenge the new minigames.

Unlock the second part of your very own Riyadh Season robot outfit! Collect 3 tickets to earn the Robot legs!

New quests to complete! Dive underwater to find treasure and escape the maze in Zombie Escape!

Welcome to the Riyadh Season on Roblox!

🐈‍⬛Enter Beast Land and challenge yourself! Play four BRAND NEW Minigames!🐈‍⬛
🧟Escape zombies and explore underwater in brand new quests! 🧟
🎉Experience the Riyadh Season on Roblox for the first time ever! 🎉
🎫Earn Golden Tickets to unlock FREE UGC 🎫 
🌍Explore BVLD world, find secrets and drive the Amphicar on roads and water🌍
🎾Play Tennis, Whack-A-Mole and escape from zombies!🎾

More updates to come!
